notes.title: May update
notes.content:
[h1]Hey detectives![/h1]

Billie Beetleneck has come far and has new art, including the final book character and a proper main menu. I'm still hopeful Billie Beetleneck will come out in the upcoming months. We'll see how things go. What's left now is Shyla's book and the conclusion of the story.

The new character is Zadok, an insane character with two sides. Gone mad for reasons that will become clear later on. Here's Zadok's character art and the new main menu background:

notes.title: Progress update, March
notes.content:
Hi detectives!

I've worked on the story for the past weeks and have now finished the second book Billie visits, as well as several scenes after he returns. I'm now at a point where the stakes and antagonist have been presented and Billie had some bonding time with his detective partner. Now it's time to truly solve the case as he moves on to the third book world. 

Apart from progress with the story, several art pieces are being worked on, including a proper main menu background and a nice looking book cover for Shyla's book.

More updates in the future! Stay tuned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344093/f26879c6dfa5a71d01045d7adcd5f4a656b03320.png[/img]

notes.title: New Characters
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I finally got more art for characters Billie will meet during his adventure.
Meet Dylanie, Joey and Shyla. All three of them will appear in the novel in book two and forward.
Commissioning these characters was easier to do thanks to the generous donations I received. Thanks again to everyone who donated!

notes.title: Billie Beetleneck was funded
notes.content:
Billie Beetleneck was successfully funded on kickstarter to aid with art commissions. A big thanks for the support! With this help, the progress on Billie Beetleneck will move quicker. There's still time to donate and get rewards for those interested here: [url=http://kck.st/40sLrus]Kickstarter page[/url]
